stem: 在考虑从供应商处购买用于客户生命周期管理的AFC工具时,在此过程中应采取以下哪两项措施？(选择两项.)

options.A: 确保工具兼容，并且能够与现有系统集成
options.B: 评估是否有内部员工能够提供这些工具的使用培训
options.C: 评估工具的实施成本和维护成本
options.D: 根据供应商工具所提供的功能来确定业务需求

stem_en: When considering purchasing AFC tools from a vendor to implement into the customer lifecycle, which of the following measures should be taken during the process? (Choose Two.)

options_en.A: Ensuring the tools are compatible and can be integrated with current systems.
options_en.B: Assessing whether internal staff members can provide training on the tools.
options_en.C: Assessing the cost of implementation and the cost of maintaining the tools.
options_en.D: Basing business requirements on the features offered by the vendor's tools.
